title: Week 3 Cheat Sheet: Latent Variables, VAE, ELBO

items.label: Latent variable model
items.note: $x$ observed, $z$ hidden; generate $z\to x$, infer $x\to z$ via the posterior. Easy sampling, hard likelihood.

items.label: PCA / linear AE
items.note: Directions of max variance; linear AE with MSE ≈ PCA (latents not necessarily orthogonal).

items.label: Why VAE
items.note: Regular AE codes: odd shape, off-centre, not continuous. VAE: Gaussian codes pulled toward $\mathcal N(0,I)$.

items.label: ELBO (Jensen)
items.note: Lower bound for any $q$; tight iff $q=p(z|x;\theta)$.

items.label: ELBO as autoencoder
items.note: Reconstruction minus KL to the prior.

items.label: Gap
items.note: Slack = KL to the true posterior.

items.label: VAE loss
items.note: Reconstruction (MSE for Gaussian, BCE for Bernoulli) + KL to $\mathcal N(0,1)$.

items.label: Marginal likelihood
items.note: Sum over all $z$: $2^{30}$ terms for 30 binary latents; naive Monte Carlo fails.

items.label: Amortised inference
items.note: One network $x\mapsto\phi$; train $\theta,\phi$ jointly by SGD with reparameterisation.

items.label: Autoencoder variants
items.note: Dropout; denoising (noisy input); sparse ($L_1$ penalty on code).
